name: envelope/acceptance-invalid-bom-prefix
description: a UTF-8 byte order mark before the JSON text: RFC 8259 §8.1 forbids adding a BOM, and strict acceptance fails closed rather than exercising the interoperability MAY-ignore; both rederivers must keep the BOM visible to the scanner instead of letting the UTF-8 decoder silently strip it (R0 KENV-04 parity case)
